lines.zh: 我贴着树冠滑过，翅膜发响。
lines.en: I glide over the treetops, membrane crackling.

lines.zh: 夜空是我的路，月光是灯。
lines.en: The night sky is my road; moonlight is my lamp.

lines.zh: 我不扇翅，让风替我抬升。
lines.en: I do not flap; I let the wind lift me.

lines.zh: 绕着你头顶画圈，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: I circle your head, lower with every pass.

lines.zh: 翅膀下的空气又冷又薄。
lines.en: The air beneath my wings is cold and thin.

lines.zh: 我从云底穿过，湿气凝在膜上。
lines.en: I pass under the clouds; damp beads on my membrane.

lines.zh: 那具鸟的身体借我飞了这些夜。
lines.en: That bird's body lent me these nights of flight.

lines.zh: 我沿着河面低飞，惊起蛙声。
lines.en: I skim the river low and startle the frogs.

lines.zh: 飞到高处的风里，我才不疼。
lines.en: Only in the high wind does the pain stop.

lines.zh: 翅尖擦过屋檐，瓦片轻响。
lines.en: My wingtip grazes the eaves; tiles click.

lines.zh: 我逆着夜风爬升，很吃力。
lines.en: I climb against the night wind, laboring.

lines.zh: 三只一起飞，影子叠成一片。
lines.en: Three of us fly, shadows folding into one.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，听下面的呼吸。
lines.en: I hover and listen to the breathing below.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有路，我照样飞。
lines.en: There is no road in the dark; I fly anyway.

lines.zh: 我沿着仪式圈的边飞了一圈。
lines.en: I fly one lap around the ritual circle's edge.

lines.zh: 我钻进烟里，再从另一边出来。
lines.en: I slip into the smoke and come out the other side.

lines.zh: 我挂在洞顶，翅膜垂下来。
lines.en: I hang from the cave roof, membranes dangling.

lines.zh: 膜上还留着上一只鸟的温度。
lines.en: The membrane still holds the last bird's warmth.

lines.zh: 我数着夜里的脚步，等它们停。
lines.en: I count the night's footsteps and wait for them to stop.

lines.zh: 没有眼皮，我只好一直看着。
lines.en: I have no eyelids, so I keep watching.

lines.zh: 风吹过骨架，发出哨音。
lines.en: Wind crosses my frame and whistles through it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔牙，牙是别人的。
lines.en: I lick my teeth; they belonged to something else.

lines.zh: 睡着的村子最安静，也最香。
lines.en: A sleeping village is quietest, and smells best.

lines.zh: 我把自己折起来，省点力气。
lines.en: I fold myself up to save strength.

lines.zh: 那圈仪式符文还在我脑子里转。
lines.en: The ritual circle still turns inside my skull.

lines.zh: 我在等天亮前最后一段黑。
lines.en: I wait for the last dark before dawn.

lines.zh: 高空很干，我的膜边缘发脆。
lines.en: The heights are dry; my membrane edges brittle.

lines.zh: 我能听见你的心跳，隔着屋顶。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through the roof.

lines.zh: 你抬头了，我就等你抬头。
lines.en: You looked up; I was waiting for that.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在夜里发光，很好找。
lines.en: Your eyes shine in the dark, easy to find.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我想看清你的睡意。
lines.en: Do not blink; I want to see how sleepy you are.

lines.zh: 你身上有床的味道，我闻得到。
lines.en: You smell of bed; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 我在你窗沿上，数你几次眨眼。
lines.en: I perch on your sill and count your blinks.

lines.zh: 你这张脸我记了三个晚上。
lines.en: I have remembered your face three nights now.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我只盯着火。
lines.en: You raise a torch; I watch only the flame.

lines.zh: 你吸气变浅了，我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: Your breaths grow shallow; I hear every one.

lines.zh: 我歪头，是因为脖子不是我的。
lines.en: I tilt my head because the neck is not mine.

lines.zh: 看够了，我就开始俯冲。
lines.en: Once I have looked enough, I dive.

lines.zh: 箭穿过膜，破洞漏风。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my membrane; the hole leaks wind.

lines.zh: 我被砍得歪了一下，又稳住。
lines.en: The cut knocks me sideways; I steady myself.

lines.zh: 肩膀裂了，飞起来发抖。
lines.en: My shoulder splits; flight turns shaky.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起死的那次。
lines.en: This blow reminds me of dying the first time.

lines.zh: 膜破了，我得找地方挂着。
lines.en: My membrane is torn; I must find somewhere to hang.

lines.zh: 我尖叫，声音比你想象的低。
lines.en: I shriek, lower than you would expect.

lines.zh: 骨头响了一声，还没断。
lines.en: A bone creaks, but it has not broken.

lines.zh: 你打中的是借来的那部分。
lines.en: You struck the borrowed part of me.

lines.zh: 我掉了几片膜，落在地上。
lines.en: A few membrane scraps fall from me to the ground.

lines.zh: 疼，但附身的东西不肯走。
lines.en: It hurts, but the thing possessing me will not leave.

lines.zh: 我不吃面包，我吃你的困意。
lines.en: I do not eat bread; I eat your sleepiness.

lines.zh: 把那块肉收起来，我不饿。
lines.en: Put that meat away; I am not hungry.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，我只想看你别睡。
lines.en: You hold something up; I only want you awake.

lines.zh: 幻翼膜对我没用，那是我掉的。
lines.en: Phantom membrane is useless to me; I shed it.

lines.zh: 我要的不是食物，是你不合眼。
lines.en: I do not want food; I want your eyes open.

lines.zh: 你诱惑不了我，我早被附身了。
lines.en: You cannot tempt me; I am already possessed.

lines.zh: 那点香气飘不上这个高度。
lines.en: That smell does not reach this height.

lines.zh: 我靠近，只是想闻闻你醒着没。
lines.en: I come close only to smell whether you are awake.

lines.zh: 拿开手，你的掌心太暖了。
lines.en: Move your hand; your palm is too warm.

lines.zh: 我更想要那张床，不是这块肉。
lines.en: I want the bed more than that piece of meat.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的骨架，硌得慌。
lines.en: You hit my frame; it is all edges.

lines.zh: 我撞在你肩上，膜皱了一块。
lines.en: I strike your shoulder and crumple a membrane.

lines.zh: 别用盾顶我，膜会缠上去。
lines.en: Do not brace with your shield; my membrane tangles on it.

lines.zh: 两个身体撞在一起，都很轻。
lines.en: Two bodies collide, both far too light.

lines.zh: 我弹开，又贴回来，像块布。
lines.en: I bounce off and drift back like cloth.

lines.zh: 你的护甲比我的牙硬。
lines.en: Your armor is harder than my teeth.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我掉了几片膜屑。
lines.en: One collision and I shed membrane flakes.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我听见自己骨响。
lines.en: We graze; I hear my own bones click.

lines.zh: 我本想绕开，风把我推过来。
lines.en: I meant to swerve; the wind pushed me in.

lines.zh: 贴着你的脸过去，是故意的。
lines.en: Passing close to your face was deliberate.

lines.zh: 幻翼不配对，我们只被召唤。
lines.en: Phantoms do not pair; we are only summoned.

lines.zh: 那圈符文里，我们排成一列。
lines.en: Inside the circle we stand in a row.

lines.zh: 两只幻翼靠近，只会互相撕。
lines.en: Two phantoms near each other only tear at each other.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是那个念咒的人。
lines.en: My partner is the one who chanted.

lines.zh: 没有雏鸟，只有下一次仪式。
lines.en: No chicks, only the next ritual.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的祭品味。
lines.en: I smell the offering on you.

lines.zh: 别把我俩关在一个笼子里。
lines.en: Do not cage the two of us together.

lines.zh: 我们之间只有借来的生命。
lines.en: Between us there is only borrowed life.

lines.zh: 靠近点，让我看看你的伤口。
lines.en: Come closer; let me see your wound.

lines.zh: 同类相认，靠的是腐味。
lines.en: We know our own by the smell of rot.

lines.zh: 我爪子里只有膜，抓不住别的。
lines.en: My claws hold only membrane, nothing else.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的膜，我不会捡。
lines.en: Membrane on the ground; I do not pick it up.

lines.zh: 我抓过一块肉，又松了爪。
lines.en: I grabbed a piece of meat and let it go.

lines.zh: 这东西太重，我带不上天。
lines.en: This is too heavy to carry into the sky.

lines.zh: 我只捡能塞进牙缝的。
lines.en: I pick up only what fits between my teeth.

lines.zh: 爪子是借来的，不太听话。
lines.en: These claws are borrowed and seldom obey.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我等它凉。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I wait for it to cool.

lines.zh: 我的膜比手好用，能兜住风。
lines.en: My membrane catches wind better than hands.

lines.zh: 捡起来也吃不下，没胃。
lines.en: I could pick it up but not eat; I have no stomach.

lines.zh: 地上那堆膜，是我留的记号。
lines.en: That heap of membrane is a mark I left.

lines.zh: 你三天没睡，我找到你了。
lines.en: Three nights without sleep; I found you.

lines.zh: 心跳最快的那一个，就是我选的。
lines.en: The fastest heartbeat is the one I choose.

lines.zh: 屋顶挡不住气味，你躲得不好。
lines.en: A roof does not stop scent; you hide poorly.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你，因为你不肯躺下。
lines.en: I have locked on because you will not lie down.

lines.zh: 那一圈符文指向你的床。
lines.en: The ritual circle points at your bed.

lines.zh: 你在跑，跑让血更响。
lines.en: You run, and running makes your blood louder.

lines.zh: 我从上面看见你了，别抬头。
lines.en: I see you from above; do not look up.

lines.zh: 今夜名单上只有你一个。
lines.en: Tonight the list has only your name.

lines.zh: 你点亮火把，等于举手。
lines.en: Lighting a torch is the same as raising your hand.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，先把你的耐心磨掉。
lines.en: I circle first to wear your patience down.

lines.zh: 那扇窗没关，我记住了。
lines.en: That window is unshut; I remembered it.

lines.zh: 目标定了，风也站在我这边。
lines.en: The target is set, and the wind is with me.

lines.zh: 再等一圈，等你眨眼。
lines.en: One more circle, until you blink.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，第三步就扑。
lines.en: I count your footfalls and pounce on the third.

lines.zh: 你退到屋檐下，我早已在那儿。
lines.en: You retreat under the eaves; I am already there.

lines.zh: 我把高度压低，压到你能听见。
lines.en: I drop lower, low enough for you to hear.

lines.zh: 别看我翅膀，看我的牙。
lines.en: Do not watch my wings; watch my teeth.

lines.zh: 盾挡正面，可我从上面来。
lines.en: The shield guards your front; I come from above.

lines.zh: 我在等风停，风一停就下来。
lines.en: I wait for the wind to drop, then I descend.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，破绽在这。
lines.en: Your breathing broke; there is the gap.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，影子先到。
lines.en: I swing behind you; my shadow arrives first.

lines.zh: 你数着我还剩几圈，对吧？
lines.en: You are counting my circles, are you not?

lines.zh: 爪子收了收，准备好。
lines.en: I flex my claws and get ready.

lines.zh: 这次不试探了，直接落。
lines.en: No more probing; this time I drop straight down.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩，牙陷进去。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder; my teeth sink in.

lines.zh: 一爪划过，你的袖子开了。
lines.en: One claw pass opens your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，再咬一口。
lines.en: I slam into you, then bite.

lines.zh: 膜扫过你的脸，你看不见了。
lines.en: My membrane sweeps your face; you cannot see.

lines.zh: 血是热的，比夜风热。
lines.en: Blood is warm, warmer than the night wind.

lines.zh: 我咬完就升，不给你还手。
lines.en: I bite and rise before you swing back.

lines.zh: 牙是别人的，咬得却很准。
lines.en: The teeth are borrowed, but the bite is sure.

lines.zh: 你倒下了，我还在你上方。
lines.en: You fall, and I stay above you.

lines.zh: 这一口，是替那只鸟咬的。
lines.en: This bite is for the bird I was made from.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的领口，找脖子。
lines.en: I tear your collar open and look for the throat.

lines.zh: 符文一亮，我从半空落出来。
lines.en: The runes flare and I drop out of the air.

lines.zh: 一只鸟的生命烧完，我醒了。
lines.en: A bird's life burned out, and I woke.

lines.zh: 祭坛上还有羽毛的味道。
lines.en: The altar still smells of feathers.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是试翅，能飞。
lines.en: My first act is testing my wings; they fly.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是我的，但归我。
lines.en: This body is not mine, but it is mine now.

lines.zh: 黑烟散了，我挂在梁上。
lines.en: The smoke clears; I hang from a beam.

lines.zh: 我从仪式圈里爬出来，翅还湿。
lines.en: I climb from the circle, wings still wet.

lines.zh: 那只鸟死前叫了一声，我记住了。
lines.en: The bird cried once before dying; I remember it.

lines.zh: 主人念完最后一个词，我就到了。
lines.en: My master spoke the last word, and I arrived.

lines.zh: 夜刚好，我出来找没睡的人。
lines.en: The night is right; I come out for the sleepless.

lines.zh: 火一碰膜，我就往上窜。
lines.en: Fire touches my membrane and I bolt upward.

lines.zh: 我很少落地，落地就很重。
lines.en: I seldom land, and landing is heavy.

lines.zh: 水灌进膜里，我拖着它沉。
lines.en: Water fills my membrane and drags me down.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，翅折了一半。
lines.en: The blast flips me; half a wing folds.

lines.zh: 箭钉在骨缝里，我带它飞。
lines.en: An arrow wedges in my joint; I fly with it.

lines.zh: 光打在我身上，附身的东西缩了。
lines.en: Light strikes me and the thing inside recoils.

lines.zh: 太久没睡意可吃，我瘦成骨架。
lines.en: Too long without sleep to feed on, I thin to bone.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，膜烧出焦边。
lines.en: Lightning hits; my membrane chars at the edges.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在扇翅。
lines.en: As I fall into nothing, I keep flapping.
